# eNet

> llms.txt for the eNet repository (embeddedos-org/eNet).
> Status: networking for EmbeddedOS (TCP/IP, UDP, DHCP, DNS,
> MQTT, CoAP). The implementation currently lives in `eos`
> (`net/`); this repository is the component's design record —
> protocol hardening, bridge evaluations and study notes.
> Whether code moves here is a merge/split decision for Aswin.

eNet is the networking component of the EmbeddedOS ecosystem.
Its docs are the org's protocol-security record: DNS and MQTT
hardening requirements with test vectors, MCP device-bridge
evaluations and trial plans, and radio/fieldbus studies.

## Docs

- [DNS resolver hardening — malformed-query requirements and test vectors](docs/dns-hardening.md)
- [MQTT broker hardening — spec and test vectors](docs/mqtt-broker-hardening.md)
- [Device bridges: the agent-fabric hardware lane for eNet](docs/device-bridges.md)
- [MCP bridge evaluation — mcp2mqtt, mcp2tcp, modbus-mcp](docs/mcp-bridge-evaluation.md)
- [MCP bridge trial plan — mcp2mqtt first, mcp2tcp bench-only](docs/mcp-bridge-trial-plan.md)
- [LoRaWAN study — native backend pattern + hardware-bridge pairing](docs/lorawan-study.md)
- [Matter / Thread landscape note (KB seed)](docs/matter-thread-note.md)
- [Sub-GHz three-way plan](docs/subghz-three-way-plan.md)
- [The deterministic-comms lane: TSN + EtherCAT](docs/tsn-ethercat-lane.md)
